## 🎓 Recommended Learning Path

### Week 1-2: Fundamentals
1. [Quick Start](wiki/01-quick-start.md) - Get the app running
2. [Architecture](wiki/02-architecture.md) - Understand structure
3. [Hooks Guide](wiki/03-hooks-guide.md) - Learn the core hooks
4. Start reading comments in `src/` code

### Week 3-4: Building
5. [State Management](wiki/04-state-management.md) - Manage app state
6. [Components](wiki/05-components-guide.md) - Component patterns
7. [Custom Hooks](wiki/06-custom-hooks.md) - Reusable logic

### Week 5-6: Real Features
8. [Pages & Features](wiki/07-pages-features.md) - How pages work
9. [Authentication](wiki/08-authentication.md) - User login systems
10. [CRUD Operations](wiki/09-crud-operations.md) - Data operations

### Week 7-8: Polish
11. [Form Handling](wiki/10-form-handling.md) - Complex forms
12. [Styling](wiki/12-styling.md) - Make it beautiful
13. [Error Handling](wiki/14-error-handling.md) - Robust apps

### Week 9-10: Master
14. [Performance](wiki/13-performance.md) - Optimize apps
15. [TypeScript](wiki/15-typescript.md) - Type safety
16. [Testing](wiki/16-testing.md) - Verify your code

## 💡 Tips for Using This Wiki

1. **Read Sequentially** - Each guide builds on previous knowledge
2. **Check Code Examples** - Every concept has working examples
3. **Follow Links** - Click related topics for deeper understanding
4. **Search for Keywords** - Use browser search to find topics
5. **Bookmark Favorites** - Save guides you refer to often
6. **Practice** - Type out examples, don't just read

## 🚀 Getting Started NOW

### Install and Run
```bash
cd React101
npm install
npm start
```

### Try the App
1. Sign up with any email
2. Create a note
3. Edit it
4. Delete it
5. Check browser console for logged concepts

### Next Steps
1. Read [Quick Start](wiki/01-quick-start.md)
2. Explore `src/` directory
3. Read code comments
4. Follow [Beginner Learning Path](#recommended-learning-path)
